title: 第十五章 你根本就不知道什么叫做可能第十六章 一招破敌全场哗然
slug: 震惊五星灵帝被逼着撩妹
lines: 祝山趴在擂台上，脸贴着地，整个人都懵了。
他刚才明明蓄满了全力的一拳，势在必得，结果还没打到杨卤，自己就先摔了个狗啃泥。这脸丢得，比直接被打飞还难看！
台下的围观弟子们也愣住了，一时间安静得可怕。
“这……这是什么情况？”
“祝师兄怎么自己摔倒了？”
“是杨卤那个凝星缚！他刚才用了凝星缚绊住了祝师兄的脚踝！”
“凝星缚？那不就是个一星基础术法吗？怎么可能绊倒二星灵王半灵境的祝山？”
“你问我我问谁？反正我就看到了！”
祝山从擂台上爬起来，拍了拍身上的灰尘，脸上青一阵白一阵，眼中满是羞恼和愤怒。
他盯着杨卤，咬着牙道：“你耍阴招？”
杨卤无辜地摊了摊手：“祝师兄，我用的是凝星缚，这是基础术法，大家都学过的。这怎么能叫耍阴招呢？你自己不小心踩到了，怎么能怪我？”
祝山气得说不出话来。
但他心里清楚，刚才那一瞬间，确实是凝星缚精准地缠住了他的脚踝，时机拿捏得恰到好处，分毫不差。这绝不是巧合，而是杨卤提前预判了他的攻击路线。
可一个二星灵王入灵境，怎么可能有这么精准的预判能力？
“再来！”祝山怒喝一声，双拳紧握，周身星力再次暴涨。
他不信邪！
他要正面碾压！
祝山再次冲了上来，这一次他没有用那种大开大合的冲撞招式，而是改成了连环快拳，拳拳生风，密集如雨。
他就不信，杨卤能一直躲下去！
“烈山劲！破！”
祝山双拳齐出，拳影漫天，带着凌厉的风压，朝杨卤笼罩而来。
杨卤站在原地，不闪不避，只是抬起双手，摆出一个最基础防御架势。
他要做什么？
硬接？
台下的弟子们瞪大了眼睛。
只见杨卤双手轻抬，掌心向外，五指微张，周身泛起一层淡淡的星力光晕——正是入门级防御功法的基础动作。
祝山的拳头砸在杨卤的掌心。
一声闷响，星力碰撞产生的气浪朝四周扩散开来，吹得擂台边缘的符文石嗡嗡作响。
但杨卤纹丝不动。
他稳稳地接住了祝山的双拳，甚至脸上还带着一丝微笑。
“祝师兄，这拳力道不错，但还差了点。”
祝山瞳孔一缩。
他刚才那两拳，虽然不算是全力，但也用了七成功力，就算是同境界的修士也不敢硬接。可杨卤不仅接住了，还接得如此轻松，轻描淡写的样子就像在接两团棉花！
“不可能！”祝山怒吼一声，抽回拳头，又是一拳轰出！
杨卤依然是老样子，抬手，硬接。
又是一记闷响。
杨卤身体微微一晃，但双脚就像钉在擂台上一样，纹丝不动。
祝山疯狂了。
他一拳接着一拳，拳拳到肉，每一拳都用上了全力。
但不管他怎么打，杨卤始终是那副不紧不慢的样子，要么侧身躲开，要么抬手硬接。他的防御架势极其基础，却稳如磐石，祝山打了几十拳，愣是没能让他后退半步。
content_en:
Zhu Shan lay on the ring with his face on the ground, completely stunned.
He had just punched with all his strength and was bound to win, but before he could hit Yang Lu, he was thrown into the mud first. This humiliation is even uglier than being beaten straight away!
The onlookers in the audience were also stunned, and for a moment it was eerily quiet.
"What...what is going on?"
"Why did Senior Brother Zhu fall down?"
"It's Yang Lu's Star-Condensing Binding! He just used the Star-Condensing Binding to trip Senior Brother Zhu's ankle!"
"Condensing Star Binding? Isn't that just a one-star basic spell? How could it possibly trip up Zhu Shan, who is in the semi-spiritual realm of a two-star spirit king?"
"Who are you asking me? Anyway, I saw it!"
Zhu Shan got up from the ring and patted the dust off his body. His face turned blue and white, and his eyes were full of shame and anger.
He stared at Yang Lu, gritted his teeth and said, "Are you playing dirty tricks?"
Yang Lu innocently spread his hands: "Brother Zhu, I used Condensing Star Binding. This is a basic technique that everyone has learned. How can this be called a dirty trick? You accidentally stepped on it yourself, how can you blame me?"
"You..."
Zhu Shan was so angry that he couldn't speak.
But he knew in his heart that at that moment, the Star Binding had indeed wrapped around his ankle accurately, and the timing was just right. This was by no means a coincidence, but Yang Lu had predicted his attack route in advance.
But how could a two-star spiritual king have such accurate prediction ability after entering the spiritual realm?
"Come again!" Zhu Shan shouted angrily, clenching his fists, and the star power around him surged again.
He doesn’t believe in evil!
He wants to crush him head-on!
Zhu Shan charged forward again. This time he did not use the wide-open and wide-open collision moves, but changed to a series of fast punches. The punches generated wind and were as dense as rain.
He didn't believe that Yang Lu could hide forever!
"Lie Shan Jin! Break!"
Zhu Shan punched out both fists, and the shadows of his fists filled the sky, carrying fierce wind pressure and shrouding Yang Lu.
Yang Lu stood on the spot, neither dodge nor dodge, but raised his hands in a basic defensive posture.
What is he going to do?
Hard connection?
The disciples in the audience widened their eyes.
Yang Lu raised his hands slightly, with his palms facing outward, his fingers slightly spread, and a faint halo of star power appearing all over his body - which was the basic movement of the entry-level defensive technique.
Zhu Shan's fist hit Yang Lu's palm.
"Bang!"
There was a muffled sound, and the air waves generated by the collision of star power spread around, making the rune stones on the edge of the ring buzz.
But Yang Lu didn't move at all.
He caught Zhu Shan's fists steadily, even with a smile on his face.
"Senior brother, this punch is good, but it's still a bit weak."
Zhu Shan's pupils shrank.
Although the two punches he just made were not full strength, they still used seven degrees of strength. Even monks in the same realm did not dare to take them forcefully. But Yang Lu not only caught it, he also caught it so easily, as if he was catching two balls of cotton!
"Impossible!" Zhu Shan roared angrily, drew back his fist, and punched out again!
Yang Lu was still the same as before, raising his hand and accepting it forcefully.
"Bang!"
There was another muffled sound.
Yang Lu's body swayed slightly, but his feet remained motionless as if they were nailed to the ring.
Zhu Shan went crazy.
He punched one after another, punching to the flesh, using all his strength in each punch.
But no matter how he hit, Yang Lu always looked unhurried, either ducking sideways or raising his hand to catch the blow. His defensive posture was extremely basic, but rock solid. Zhu Shan punched him dozens of times, but was unable to make him take even a step back.
title_en: Chapter 15 You don’t even know what possibility means Chapter 16 Defeat the enemy with one move and the whole audience is in an uproar
